fusions.name: Skittering Blight
fusions.desc: You rush to the target, then bite for 12 damage and leave it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The hit has a 40% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cellar Dust
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of spores 5 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. You hold 4 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Underfoot Dash
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Burrowed Colony
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, a ward of mycelium absorbs damage equal to 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
